WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS conservation_count
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT healtheval,
         conservation_count,
         CAST(conservation_count AS REAL) / SUM(conservation_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT AVG(ss.conservation_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(ss.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(ss.share - a.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM status_shares AS ss
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE ss.share > a.average_share;
